target.title: fix(ui): explain replace-mode filtering in model picker
target.body:
Closes #104545

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users with `models.mode: "replace"` would see only explicitly configured models in the Control UI without any explanation, making newly bundled or discovered models appear unsupported.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing replace-mode filtering remains unchanged. Configured model-list responses now carry additive `catalogMode: "replace"` metadata, and the chat model picker plus Quick Settings use it to show a localized explanation with a direct "Manage models" action. Full-catalog (`view: "all"`) responses do not carry the hint metadata.

## User Impact

Users can immediately tell that their local replace-mode configuration is filtering the catalog and can open model settings to add models or change the catalog mode, instead of debugging upstream model support.

## Evidence

- Focused gateway and UI regressions: 6 files, 256 tests passed.
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/chat/models.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-state.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-view.test.ts ui/src/pages/config/quick.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/models.test.ts`
- Browser regression: `ui/src/e2e/chat-composer-redesign.e2e.test.ts`, 7 tests passed with the repository's UI E2E Vitest config.
- Deterministic visual proof against a mocked `chat.metadata` replace-mode response:
  - desktop 1280x900: hint and action visible; menu contained within viewport; no horizontal overflow
  - mobile 393x852: 369px menu contained within viewport; hint wraps cleanly; no horizontal overflow
- Type-aware oxlint passed for all touched TypeScript files.
- Control UI i18n check passed for all 20 locales; new keys use generated English fallbacks.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Repository autoreview completed clean with no actionable findings.

Before: the configured model rows were shown with no indication that replace mode hid other catalog entries.

After: the picker and Quick Settings state, "Replace mode shows only models explicitly listed in Settings," with a "Manage models" action.

Crabbox was unavailable in this checkout, so visual proof used the repository's deterministic Control UI mock gateway and local Chromium fallback. The standard E2E wrapper's dependency preflight rejected the isolated worktree's linked `node_modules`; the same E2E Vitest config was run directly and passed.

AI-assisted: Codex was used to implement and review this change. No agent transcript is attached.
